categories.name: Person
categories.definition: Named individuals, including historical figures, celebrities, athletes, and fictional characters.

categories.name: Location
categories.definition: Geographical entities such as countries, cities, towns, mountains, bodies of water, and addresses.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: Formal groups, associations, companies, institutions, government bodies, and sports teams.

categories.name: Creative Work
categories.definition: Titles of artistic or intellectual productions such as films, books, plays, songs, and television shows.

categories.name: Event
categories.definition: Named occurrences, incidents, competitions, and battles that take place at a specific time.

categories.name: Product
categories.definition: Manufactured goods, vehicle models, software, food items, and commercial brand names.

categories.name: Award
categories.definition: Prizes, honors, and decorations given for achievement.

categories.name: Language
categories.definition: Specific human languages or dialects.

categories.name: Ethnicity or Nationality
categories.definition: Terms denoting a group of people sharing a common national or cultural identity.

categories.name: Biological Taxon
categories.definition: Scientific names of biological species, genera, or families.

categories.name: Disease or Medical Condition
categories.definition: Specific illnesses, disorders, or medical syndromes.

categories.name: Chemical Substance
categories.definition: Specific chemical compounds, elements, or drugs.

categories.name: Title or Position
categories.definition: Formal titles, ranks, or specific job roles held by an individual.

categories.name: Transportation Route
categories.definition: Named roads, streets, highways, railway lines, and flight routes.

categories.name: Facility or Infrastructure
categories.definition: Physical structures such as airports, stadiums, bridges, and power plants.

categories.name: Currency
categories.definition: Monetary units and currency codes.

categories.name: Religion
categories.definition: Specific religious systems, denominations, or sects.

categories.name: Vehicle
categories.definition: Specific named instances of vehicles, typically ships or aircraft.

categories.name: Legislation
categories.definition: Specific laws, acts, or statutes.

categories.name: Software
categories.definition: Specific computer programs, operating systems, or software versions.

categories.name: Geographical Feature

categories.name: Celestial Object
categories.definition: Named features on planets or moons, such as craters or ridges.

categories.name: Animal
categories.definition: Specific types or species of animals, distinct from scientific taxa.

categories.name: Literary or Artwork Component
categories.definition: Specific named parts of larger works, such as chapters, articles, or movements.

categories.name: Political Party
categories.definition: Specific political organizations or alliances.

categories.name: Sports League
categories.definition: Specific organized groups of sports teams or competitions.

categories.name: Educational Institution
categories.definition: Schools, colleges, and universities.

categories.name: Military Equipment
categories.definition: Specific models of weapons, vehicles, or machinery used in warfare.

categories.name: Time Period
categories.definition: Named historical eras or periods.

categories.name: Concept
categories.definition: Abstract ideas, theories, or general terms not fitting other categories.
